title: Learning inadequacy of Bayesian neural operators for PDE-constrained inference and design
abstract: arXiv:2611.19115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Partial differential equations (PDEs) underpin predictive modeling across science, engineering and medicine. Their use in digital twins, parameter inference and optimal design requires repeated solutions across parameters and scenarios. For nonlinear, transient and multiphysics systems, these calculations can make numerical simulation prohibitively expensive. Here we introduce the residual-informed Bayesian neural operator (RI-BNO), which learns operator inadequacy using a posteriori error estimates from the governing PDEs and incorporates its correction and uncertainty into Bayesian training and prediction. We establish local error bounds for the residual-informed estimates under stability and smoothness assumptions. translated_title: 面向偏微分方程约束推断与设计的贝叶斯神经算子不足性学习
translated_abstract: 偏微分方程（PDE）是科学、工程和医学领域预测建模的基础。它们在数字孪生、参数推断和最优设计中的应用，需要在不同的参数与场景下进行反复求解。对于非线性、瞬态和多物理场系统，这类计算可能使数值模拟的代价高得难以承受。本文提出了残差信息贝叶斯神经算子（RI-BNO），它利用控制方程的后验误差估计来学习神经算子的不足性，并将其校正和不确定性纳入贝叶斯训练与预测之中。在稳定性和光滑性假设下，我们为残差信息估计建立了局部误差界。我们在非线性反应扩散基准问题上结合DeepONet与潜在子空间架构、基于磁共振成像的胶质瘤参数场马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗推断，以及蒙特卡……（原文摘要截断）上对RI-BNO进行了演示。
tldr: 本文提出残差信息贝叶斯神经算子（RI-BNO），利用控制方程的后验误差估计学习神经算子的不足性，并将其校正与不确定性融入贝叶斯训练和预测，为PDE约束下的推断与设计提供了高效且带误差界的可靠框架。
en_tdlr: We introduce the residual-informed Bayesian neural operator (RI-BNO), which learns operator inadequacy from a posteriori error estimates of the governing PDEs and incorporates its correction and uncertainty into Bayesian training and prediction, enabling reliable PDE-constrained inference and design with local error bounds.
